en: Colorized vintage view of a riverside promenade with a woman in traditional dress leaning on a wooden fence by a wide river. Across the river stands a bridge and a row of ornate multi‑story buildings. Behind the town rises a steep, green hill crowned with fortification walls and towers. At the top left of the image text reads "GRAZ. — Mur Schlossberg." indicating the scene shows the Schlossberg hill by the Mur River in Graz.
